text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Espo-san. Tran-san and I 
made a 'gaming cake' for you~"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Yep. Decorated with seven-colored cream, 
and with sanitized LED lights jammed in 
instead of candles~."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No, if you're gonna make one, just make a 
normal one! Nobody asked for your weird 
little quirks!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, hear me out~. Accu-san 
has some selling points to pitch too, 
y'know!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, actually, each color has a different 
cream flavor, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Red is strawberry, orange is orange, 
yellow is lemon, green is muscat grape, 
and blue is, um—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...Damn it, it's packed with fruit and 
looks genuinely delicious!?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright, fine, bring it on! I'll eat it, 
dammit! You better have some tea ready 
too, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll get that ready along with 
some nice warm tea~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go get the LEDs ready to 
shine, then.
